glossary.definition: A secure electronic place to store money on your phone, similar to a physical wallet but for digital transactions
Converting digital money in your wallet to physical cash (banknotes)
Namibian National QR Code standard (version 5.0) used for interoperable payments and cash-outs across banks and wallets
Unstructured Supplementary Service Data - A technology that lets you access banking services by dialing codes (like *140#) on any phone, even without internet
Know Your Customer - The process of verifying your identity to comply with banking regulations
A verification process to confirm that grant and pension recipients are still alive and eligible to receive payments
Government-to-Person payments like social grants, pensions, and subsidies disbursed directly to citizens
Person-to-Person payments - Sending money directly from one individual to another
A secure system that lets you safely share your bank account information with other apps like Smartpay to access better services
Bank of Namibia Position Paper Standard-3 - Regulations that set limits on e-money transactions based on your verification level

faq_general.question: Is Smartpay safe to use?
faq_general.answer:
Yes! Smartpay is regulated by the Bank of Namibia and uses bank-level security including:
• End-to-end encryption (TLS 1.3)
• PIN and biometric authentication
• PSD-3 compliance for consumer protection
• Real-time fraud detection
• Audit logs for all transactions

Your money is protected by Namibian banking regulations.

faq_general.question: Do I need a smartphone?
faq_general.answer: No! While the smartphone app provides the best experience, you can use Smartpay on any phone through USSD. Just dial *140# to access basic banking services like checking balance, sending money, and cashing out. USSD works without internet connection.

faq_general.question: What happens if I lose my phone?
faq_general.answer:
Your money is safe! Immediately:
1. Call Smartpay support to freeze your account
2. Use USSD from another phone to check balance
3. Get a new phone and reinstall the app
4. Log in with your credentials
5. Set up biometric authentication again

Nobody can access your wallet without your PIN and biometric data. Your transaction history and balance remain safe.

faq_general.question: How do I get help if I have a problem?
faq_general.answer:
Multiple support channels are available:
• In-app chat (fastest response)
• WhatsApp: +264 XXX XXXX
• Phone: 061-XXX-XXX (toll-free)
• Email: support@smartpay.na
• Visit any partner agent or bank branch
• Report incidents in the app

Support is available 24/7 for urgent issues.

faq_general.question: Can I use Smartpay in rural areas?
faq_general.answer:
Yes! Smartpay is designed for both urban and rural users:
• USSD works everywhere with mobile signal
• Agent network covers rural areas
• NamPost branches in most towns
• Offline transactions support
• SMS notifications when internet is unavailable

You don't need constant internet access.

faq_general.question: What if the app doesn't work?
faq_general.answer:
Try these steps:
1. Check your internet connection
2. Close and restart the app
3. Update to the latest version
4. Clear app cache
5. Use USSD as backup (*140#)
6. Contact support if problem persists

USSD always works as a fallback, even if the app has issues.

regulatory_info.title: Bank of Namibia Regulation
regulatory_info.summary: Smartpay operates under Bank of Namibia oversight and complies with all national banking regulations
regulatory_info.content:
Smartpay is regulated by the Bank of Namibia and complies with:
• Position Paper Standard-3 (PSD-3) for e-money limits
• National Payment System rules
• Data Protection Act
• Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations
• Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements

These regulations protect consumers and ensure the safety and integrity of the financial system.

regulatory_info.title: Transaction Limits (PSD-3)
regulatory_info.summary: Legal limits on daily transactions and wallet balances based on verification level
regulatory_info.content:
PSD-3 regulations set transaction limits to protect consumers:

**Basic Tier** (Phone verification only)
• Daily limit: N$1,000
• Wallet balance limit: N$5,000
• Single transaction: N$500

**Intermediate Tier** (ID verification)
• Daily limit: N$5,000
• Wallet balance limit: N$25,000
• Single transaction: N$2,500

**Full Tier** (Proof of address + biometric)
• Daily limit: N$50,000
• Wallet balance limit: N$250,000
• Single transaction: N$25,000

These limits are mandated by law for consumer protection.

regulatory_info.title: Privacy & Data Protection
regulatory_info.summary: How your personal and financial data is protected under Namibian law
regulatory_info.content:
Smartpay complies with the Namibian Data Protection Act:

**Your Rights:**
• Right to access your data
• Right to correction of errors
• Right to deletion (after account closure)
• Right to data portability
• Right to withdraw consent

**Data Security:**
• All data encrypted at rest and in transit
• Access controls and audit logs
• Regular security audits
• Data minimization (only collect what's needed)
• No data selling to third parties

**Data Usage:**
• Transaction processing
• Fraud prevention
• Regulatory compliance
• Service improvement
• Customer support

You can request a copy of your data or deletion at any time through Settings → Privacy.

how_to_guides.title: How to Upgrade Your Verification Level
how_to_guides.summary: Step-by-step guide to increase your transaction limits by completing KYC verification

steps.title: Go to Profile
steps.description: Open the Smartpay app and tap your profile picture in the top right corner

steps.title: Select 'Verification'
steps.description: Tap on 'Verification Level' to see your current tier and available upgrades

steps.title: Choose Tier
steps.description: Select the tier you want to upgrade to (Intermediate or Full)

steps.title: Provide Documents
steps.description:
For Intermediate: Upload ID photo
For Full: Upload ID + proof of address + take selfie

steps.title: Wait for Approval
steps.description: Verification usually takes 1-24 hours. You'll get an SMS when approved.

steps.title: Enjoy Higher Limits
steps.description: Once approved, your new limits are active immediately

how_to_guides.title: How to Find and Use Cash-Out Agents
how_to_guides.summary: Complete guide to withdrawing cash from your wallet using local agents

steps.title: Open Agent Finder
steps.description: In the app, tap 'Cash Out' then 'Find Agent' or ask the copilot 'Find nearest agent'

steps.title: Allow Location
steps.description: Grant location permission so the app can find agents near you

steps.title: Select Agent
steps.description: See a list of nearby agents with distances. Choose one and tap 'Get Directions'

steps.title: Generate Code
steps.description: At the agent, tap 'Generate Cash-Out Code' and enter the amount you want

steps.title: Show QR Code
steps.description: Show the QR code or secure code to the agent. They'll scan it.

steps.title: Receive Cash
steps.description: The agent gives you cash. Check your SMS and app for transaction confirmation.

tips: Verify the agent is authorized (check their license displayed at the shop)
Count your money before leaving the agent
Keep your PIN secret - never share it with the agent
Check transaction history after cash-out to confirm

fees_info.title: How Smartpay Fees Work
fees_info.summary: What fees you may pay and how to confirm them before sending money
fees_info.content:
Smartpay may charge fees for certain actions (for example: cash-out, transfers, or partner services). Before you confirm a transaction, always check:

• The fee amount
• The total amount that will be deducted
• The recipient/agent name (who will receive the money)

If anything looks wrong, cancel and contact support. Never send a transaction just because someone is pressuring you.

fees_info.title: Proof Before You Pay
fees_info.summary: A simple checklist to avoid being overcharged
fees_info.content:
Use this checklist before you pay:

1. Confirm the exact amount and fee
2. Confirm the recipient/agent identity
3. Only proceed if you initiated the transaction
4. Keep your receipt (SMS + in-app history)

If a merchant/agent refuses to show fees or tries to rush you, walk away and report it in the app.

fraud_and_scams.title: The Golden Rule: Never Share Your PIN or OTP
fraud_and_scams.summary: Smartpay staff and agents will never ask for your PIN, OTP, or password
fraud_and_scams.content:
Never share:
• Your PIN
• One-Time Passwords (OTP)
• Passwords
• Card CVV

Scammers may pretend to be “support”, “a bank”, or “an agent” over WhatsApp/SMS/phone. If someone asks for your PIN/OTP, it is a scam. End the call and contact Smartpay support using the official channels in the app.

fraud_and_scams.title: Common Scam Scripts to Watch For
fraud_and_scams.summary: Examples of what scammers say and how to respond
fraud_and_scams.content:
Be careful if someone says:

• “I can increase your limits / unlock your account. Send your OTP.”
• “You won a grant. Pay a small fee first.”
• “We sent money by mistake. Send it back now.”
• “Your SIM will be blocked. Confirm your OTP.”

How to respond:
1. Do not share codes
2. Verify using official support
3. If you already shared a code, freeze your account immediately and report it

fraud_and_scams.title: If You Think You Were Scammed
fraud_and_scams.summary: What to do in the first 5 minutes
fraud_and_scams.content:
Act quickly:

1. Freeze your Smartpay account (Settings → Security → Freeze)
2. Change your PIN/password
3. Report the incident in-app (include the phone number, screenshots, and transaction ID)
4. If you suspect a SIM swap, contact your mobile network operator immediately

The faster you report, the more we can do to protect your account and investigate.

rights_and_help.title: Your Rights as a Smartpay User
rights_and_help.summary: Key consumer rights in simple language
rights_and_help.content:
You have the right to:
• Clear information about fees and limits before you confirm
• Safe handling of your personal data
• Access your transaction history and receipts
• Report fraud and get a reference number
• Ask for help and escalate complaints

If you don’t understand a fee, a limit, or a message, pause and ask the copilot or support before continuing.

rights_and_help.title: How to Report a Problem (Best Practice)
rights_and_help.summary: How to report issues so support can resolve them faster
rights_and_help.content:
When reporting a problem, include:
• The transaction ID (from History)
• Date/time
• Amount
• Recipient/agent name
• Screenshots of any messages
• The phone number that contacted you (for scams)

This helps support investigate quickly and reduces back-and-forth.
